blurb: Mole, Ratty, Badger and the very boastful Toad of Toad Hall, by the river and in the Wild Wood.
source: Text: The Wind in the Willows by Kenneth Grahame (1908), from the Standard Ebooks edition. Public domain.

streets.name: The River Bank
streets.blurb: Mole throws down his brush, leaves his spring-cleaning, and discovers the river.
streets.how: Row up the river with Ratty. Pick up the picnic and keep clear of the snags.

params.done: Nothing half so much worth doing as messing about in boats.

streets.name: The Open Road
streets.blurb: Toad’s new craze is a canary-yellow caravan — until a motor-car roars past.
streets.how: Race along the open road. Jump the ruts and dodge the stones — and watch out for the motor-car!

streets.name: The Wild Wood
streets.blurb: Mole goes into the Wild Wood alone — and the snow begins to fall.
streets.how: Creep through the snowy Wild Wood to Badger’s door. Keep out of sight of the weasels, and hide in the bushes.

streets.name: Mr. Badger
streets.blurb: Badger takes them into his warm, safe house under the Wild Wood.
streets.how: Explore Badger’s big underground kitchen and find six cosy things.

finale.say: Make yourselves at home. Nobody comes to harm in my house.

streets.name: Dulce Domum
streets.blurb: On a cold winter evening Mole suddenly smells his old home, somewhere very close.
streets.how: Look for the clues in the snowy village, then work out how Mole can find his way home.

clues.label: A lit window
clues.text: Warm windows glow in the village. Mole and Rat look in, far from home themselves.

clues.label: A faint smell
clues.text: Something reaches Mole through the cold air, like an electric shock: his own home, calling him.

clues.label: A little door
clues.text: A little front door with “Mole End” painted over the bell-pull.

solve.label: Mole End
solve.prompt: How does Mole find his old home?
options: He follows the smell — his home is calling him
The field mice lead him there
solve.hint: What reached Mole like an electric shock?

streets.name: Mr. Toad
streets.blurb: Toad can’t resist motor-cars — and this time he drives off in one that isn’t his.
streets.how: Run! Get to the end of the lane before the policeman catches up with you.

streets.name: The Piper at the Gates of Dawn
streets.blurb: Little Portly the otter is missing, and Mole and Rat row out at night to look for him.
streets.how: Hop along the river on the floating logs and lily pads, and search for Portly.

finale.say: Here I am! I fell asleep… and I heard the most beautiful music.

streets.name: Toad’s Adventures
streets.blurb: Toad is locked in the darkest dungeon of the castle — but the gaoler’s daughter has an idea.
streets.how: Look at the clues in Toad’s cell, then work out how he can escape.

clues.label: The gaoler’s daughter
clues.text: She feels sorry for Toad, and brings him buttered toast and tea.

clues.label: The washing basket
clues.text: Her aunt is a washerwoman who does the washing for all the prisoners.

clues.label: A bundle
clues.text: A cotton print gown, an apron, a shawl and a rusty black bonnet.

solve.label: The castle gate
solve.prompt: How does Toad get out of the castle?
options: Dressed in the washerwoman’s gown and bonnet
By flying out of the window
solve.hint: Who is allowed to walk in and out with the washing?

streets.name: Wayfarers All
streets.blurb: The swallows are leaving, and a seafaring rat tells Ratty about the warm South.
streets.how: Find six things from the Sea Rat’s travels, then talk to him.

finale.say: Ah, the call of the South! But your home is here, by your river, with your friends.

streets.name: The Further Adventures of Toad
streets.blurb: Toad is on the run in his washerwoman disguise — by train, by barge and on horseback.
streets.how: Race along the canal towpath. Collect the tickets and coins you need on the way.

streets.name: Toad’s Tears
streets.blurb: The Stoats and Weasels have taken Toad Hall. But Badger knows a secret.
streets.how: Look at Badger’s clues, then put the plan in order.

params.objective: Plan the attack on Toad Hall

clues.label: The old map
clues.text: An underground passage leads from the riverbank right up into the middle of Toad Hall.

clues.label: Otter’s news
clues.text: Tomorrow night the Chief Weasel is giving a birthday banquet in the dining hall.

clues.label: The butler’s pantry
clues.text: The passage comes up under the butler’s pantry, next to the dining hall.

solve.label: The plan
items: Go into the passage from the riverbank
Creep along underground to Toad Hall
Come up in the butler’s pantry
Surprise the weasels at their banquet
solve.hint: Start at the riverbank and end at the banquet.

skyRun.name: The Roofs of Toad Hall
skyRun.blurb: across the rooftops and chimneys of Toad Hall.
skyRun.how: Leap from chimney to chimney up over the roofs of Toad Hall.

npcs.name: the Water Rat
npcs.idle: Believe me, there is nothing half so much worth doing as simply messing about in boats.

steps.text: Talk to Ratty outside Toad Hall.
steps.say: I’m packing a picnic for Mole — but the wind has blown half of it along the bank! Could you find six things for the basket?

steps.text: Find six picnic things along the bank.
Bring the picnic back to Ratty.

vault.name: The Return of Ulysses
vault.blurb: an escape room in the banqueting hall of Toad Hall: did Toad learn his lesson, or didn’t he?
vault.intro: Toad Hall is back! But before the banquet can start, three locks must open. Show what happened — and decide whether Toad really changed.

stations.label: The portraits
stations.text: Match each friend to how they helped Toad.
stations.lesson: Toad got his home back because his friends never gave up on him.

pairs: Took Toad in when he came back

stations.label: Toad’s mirror
stations.text: At the banquet, Toad makes no speeches and sings no songs. He sends thanks and a gift to the gaoler’s daughter and pays the engine-driver back.
stations.lesson: “He was indeed an altered Toad!” — though his friends kept a very close eye on him.

solve.prompt: What does the ending show about Toad?
options: He has learned to be modest and grateful — at least for now
He has learned nothing at all
He has decided to buy another motor-car
solve.hint: Look at how Toad behaves at the banquet.

quiz.label: The banquet menu
quiz.lesson: Mole, Ratty, Badger and Toad, together again.

vault.openText: The doors of the banqueting hall swing wide.
vault.outro: Toad Hall is Toad’s again — and the Wild Wood is friendly at last.
